justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-modeled enum with distinct variants carrying relevant data (the offending value or character), and the lookup table uses a tuple array appropriate for the small fixed domain.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningfully distinguished variants, no panics in library paths, and the only unreachable!() is guarded by a prior exhaustive character check making it sound.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with doc comments on all public items, sensible derives (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq) on the error, Display implemented, and naming consistent with std conventions.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses matches!, iterator-style for loop over the table, ? operator, slice-based parsing with get/copied/map, and avoids unnecessary clones in a clean idiomatic style.
